sponsor_or_proposer: Nogaholding / Bapco Energies (chairman Nasser bin Hamad Al Khalifa)
current_state: Purely exploratory. Stated at CeraWeek March 2023 as part of Bahrain's decarbonization plan to cut domestic gas use and export surplus gas. No sponsor SPV formed, no location, no capacity disclosed, no FID/FEED/MOU/tender. Quote: 'Floating LNG is difficult to get right now ... my team are approaching a solution for that.' No subsequent concrete development reported through 2026.
missing_threshold_elements: No identified sponsor entity/JV, no approximate location, no concrete step taken (no FEED, FID, MOU, or tender). Capacity unknown.
watch_for: Formation of an export JV/SPV, a FEED contract, a partner MOU, an export-terminal tender, or any siting announcement (likely offshore/near Hidd).
notes: Bahrain is a small gas producer (~2 bcf/d, all domestic) and a net LNG importer since 2019/2025; an export terminal would be a strategic reversal and remains aspirational. Corroborating source: https://tankstorage.com/all-news/terminal-news/bahrain-explores-lng-export-terminal/ . Below the discovery 'sufficient information to add' bar -> monitor only, not a new_terminal.
